author: Al Jazeera English
description:
More than 80 countries have issued a joint statement at the United Nations strongly condemning Israel's unilateral measures in the occupied West Bank, including actions they say aim to expand Israel's unlawful presence and alter the demographic composition of Palestinian territory. 
Palestinian Ambassador Riyad Mansour read the statement on behalf of the coalition of 85 member states and several international organisations.
The signatories reiterated their opposition to any form of annexation and rejection of measures affecting areas occupied since 1967, including East Jerusalem. 
The Security Council is set to hold its monthly meeting on the Middle East on Wednesday, with expected focus on Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

Al Jazeera's Gabriel Elizondo reports from the United Nations in New York.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Thousands of people have taken to the streets of Misrata to commemorate the 14th anniversary of Libya's February 17th revolution in 2011. 
The city, which suffered some of the heaviest destruction and casualties during the uprising, regards the date as sacred despite ongoing political divisions and hardship. 
Since 2011, Libya has been split between two rival governments: the internationally recognised administration in the west and a parallel government controlled by Khalifa Haftar in the east. 
Residents chose to hold their own grassroots celebration ahead of Thursday's official ceremony, rejecting what many see as politically motivated events disconnected from popular sentiment.

Al Jazeera's Malik Traina reports from Misrata, Libya.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
A Chilean court is considering a criminal complaint accusing a former Israeli army sniper of war crimes committed in Gaza. 
The case invokes universal jurisdiction, a legal principle applied when a suspect's home country refuses to prosecute crimes against humanity. 
Rom Kovtun, who served with Israel's 424th Shaked Battalion, is accused of participating in the siege of al-Shifa Hospital in 2024, which led to an estimated 500 deaths. 
The complaint was filed by the Hind Rajab Foundation (HRF) after Kovtun posted images from his military service and a holiday in Chile on social media.

Al Jazeera's Lucia Newman reports from Santiago, Chile.
